findings.claim: run_discovery and run_validation write summary.json / result.json without recording the new Study options (pool_version, pool_units, panel_format, pool_keys), so an E5 result directory produced with the v3 pool or as-traded bands does not self-describe which detection pool its controls were matched on; the only trace is the presence of volatility_q / close_as_traded columns in the CSVs.
findings.evidence: summary dict at e1.py:509-519 and result.update at 532-535 contain protocol_id, protocol_sha256, panel_sha256, market, stage, code, computed_at only; neither references study.pool_version, study.pool_units or study.panel_format. The harness pattern the task says to imitate records its configuration (e3.py:174/190 and e4.py:154/170 read and write recorded["config"]), and the E5 draft's matched_controls section requires v2 and v3 results to be distinguishable ("v2 reported for comparability"). Confirmed by reading the branch file whole; git diff ae2cbee shows no change to either function.
findings.fix: In run_discovery and run_validation add an additive block, emitted only when any option is non-default so E1/E2 re-runs keep their current key set, e.g. opts = {"panel_format": study.panel_format, "pool_units": study.pool_units, "pool_version": study.pool_version, "pool_keys": list(study.pool_keys)}; if (study.pool_units, study.pool_version) != ("panel", "v1"): summary["study_options"] = opts (same for result). Add a test asserting the key is absent on the default path and present with the right values under pool_version="v3" / pool_units="as_traded" (write to a tempdir).

findings.claim: _declared_panel_format raises AttributeError rather than the documented ValueError when protocol["markets"] or protocol["data"] is present but not a dict (list or string); only the per-market entry is isinstance-guarded.
findings.evidence: Probe run in the worktree: _declared_panel_format({'markets': ['IDX']}, None) -> AttributeError 'list' object has no attribute 'get'; ({'markets': 'IDX'}) -> AttributeError; ({'data': 'panel-v2'}) -> AttributeError. Dict-shaped entries resolve correctly ({'IDX': None} and {'IDX': {'panel_format': None}} -> panel-v2; real E1/E2 protocols -> panel-v2, panel-global-v1, panel-global-v1).
findings.fix: Guard both containers: markets = proto.get("markets"); market = markets.get(self.profile.market) if isinstance(markets, dict) else None; data = proto.get("data"); global_ = data.get("panel_format") if isinstance(data, dict) else None. Optionally raise ValueError naming the malformed key.

findings.claim: The builder's claim that one frozen E5 protocol can now serve all three markets holds only if the frozen file also carries E2-shaped top-level periods and weak_signals; the E5 draft (reference material) has neither, so it is not loadable by e1.Study independent of the markets-block shape. The builder's needs_other_file note covers only the markets entries.
findings.evidence: e1.py:145-147 reads proto["weak_signals"]["continuous"], proto["weak_signals"]["binary"] and {k: tuple(v) for k, v in proto["periods"].items()}. Probe of /home/user/KOD-Machine/handoff/kod-next-move/synthesis/E5_CEILING_protocol_draft.json: 'weak_signals' in draft -> False (KeyError on load); draft periods['discovery'] is a dict keyed by market (tuple(dict) would yield ('IDX','US','CRYPTO'), not dates). E2's protocol has single top-level periods lists and a weak_signals block with continuous/binary.
findings.fix: No change to e1.py required. Extend the needs_other_file note for the Phase 2b owner: research/E5/protocol.json must carry top-level periods as {"discovery": [start, end], "validation": [start, end]} (a single 2020-07-01 start is clipped to the IDX panel's first session by Market.bounds, so one block can serve all markets) and a weak_signals block with continuous/binary lists, in addition to dict-shaped markets entries with panel_format.

findings.claim: protocol_with() creates a fresh tempfile.mkdtemp() directory per call and never removes it, so every test run leaks roughly two dozen temp directories.
findings.evidence: protocol_with is called in 20+ places across DefaultsUnchanged, PanelFormatFromProtocol, PerMarketPanelFormat and AsTradedPool; Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) at line 59 has no matching cleanup or TemporaryDirectory context.
findings.fix: Create one tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() per class in setUpClass (registered with cls.addClassCleanup(tmp.cleanup)) and have protocol_with write uniquely named files into it, or use unittest's addCleanup in each test.
